A SMALL GUIDE

Take your time.

慢一点，也很好。

  1. Breathe into the glass 呼气 · 生雾

    With the camera on, opening your mouth creates mist around its mirrored position. Or hold Breathe / Space to mist near your pointer.张嘴会在嘴部对应位置起雾，也可按住呼气按钮或空格。

  2. Trace with your fingertip 抬手 · 擦写

    Extend your index finger and move slowly. Bend it or leave the frame to lift your pen. A mouse or touch also works. Your actual movement leaves a clear trail. Keep your face and hand in frame; step back slightly if the cursor ring is missing. A fine trace width often keeps marks easier to read.伸出食指移动擦写，弯曲食指抬笔；脸和手都入镜。没出现圆圈时稍微后退。较细的线条更容易看清。

  3. Stay, and let it fall 停留 · 滴落

    Hold your drawing position for two seconds to release a droplet. A warm solid colour makes marks and water easier to see.在同一位置停留两秒，水滴落下。暖色纯背景更容易看清雾和水痕。

  4. Keep the moment 留住这一刻

    Choose a background first. Select Hold this moment, then Make a poster. Add a note and choose Keep in film collection or Export poster.先选背景，再点“定格”，然后制作海报、留言，最后收藏或导出。

The camera asks for permission. Processing stays on this device; no uploads or audio recording. Mouth opening is a breath proxy, and a two-second droplet is a designed response, not a physical measurement.摄像头在本机处理；张嘴模拟呼气，两秒滴水是设计规则。
